name: 78624 · Fredericksbrg, TX
findings: ZIP 78624 (Fredericksbrg) has 150 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78624 (Fredericksbrg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
